text:
Dear group,
I will have the B1 visa interview in september ( non married couple ) . I was wondering if they normally make a decision on the same day or if they need more  time to decide. 

I know that every case is different , but I just wanted to hear some experiences from you.  So far I didn't experience difficulties , it's just a very slow process . The last time that my B2 was extended was until the interview date .

Thank you !
